    server-init         initialize persistent server configuration and an
                        owner account
    serve               run the local workbench
    desktop             run the frameless system-tray window
    remote              open a remote ARK project through SSH
    mobile-tunnel       publish a loopback ARK server to the LAN for phone
                        pairing (SSH local forward)

    demo                create the PredActor demo project
    export              export a project
    agent               local agent context
    session-watch       upload an external agent's session JSONL to ARK at an
                        interval (opt-in)
    skills              discover ARK skills and render/validate their
                        templates

usage: arkstudio serve [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--require-auth] [--root ROOT]
                       [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--no-demo]
                       [--media-root MEDIA_ROOT]
                       [--sessions-root SESSIONS_ROOT]
                       [--public-url PUBLIC_URL] [--expose]
                       [--auth-user AUTH_USER] [--auth-password AUTH_PASSWORD]
                       [--auth-password-file AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE]
                       [--auth-password-hash AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH]
                       [--auth-session-ttl AUTH_SESSION_TTL]
                       [--public-ip PUBLIC_IP] [--detect-public-ip]
                       [--trust-proxy]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       persistent server JSON configuration
  --require-auth        refuse to start without account authentication
  --root ROOT
  --host HOST           bind address (default: 127.0.0.1; 0.0.0.0 with
                        --expose or ARK_PUBLIC)
  --port PORT
  --no-demo             do not create the starter demo project
  --media-root MEDIA_ROOT
                        allow local media under this folder (repeatable)
  --sessions-root SESSIONS_ROOT
                        task-agent session logs (default: <root>/../agent-
                        sessions)
  --public-url PUBLIC_URL
                        advertised base URL for phone pairing (or
                        ARK_PUBLIC_URL)
  --expose              bind 0.0.0.0 for phone/public access; requires account
                        authentication (or ARK_PUBLIC=1)
  --auth-user AUTH_USER
                        sign-in username (or ARK_AUTH_USER)
  --auth-password AUTH_PASSWORD
                        sign-in password; visible in the process list, prefer
                        ARK_AUTH_PASSWORD
  --auth-password-file AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE
                        read the sign-in password from a file (or
                        ARK_AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE)
  --auth-password-hash AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH
                        PBKDF2 hash instead of a plaintext password (or
                        ARK_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH)
  --auth-session-ttl AUTH_SESSION_TTL
                        sign-in session seconds (default: 43200; or
                        ARK_AUTH_SESSION_TTL)
  --public-ip PUBLIC_IP
                        explicit public IP for pairing URLs (or ARK_PUBLIC_IP)
  --detect-public-ip    opt in to one short public-IP lookup for pairing (or
                        ARK_DETECT_PUBLIC_IP=1)
  --trust-proxy         trust X-Forwarded-For/Proto/Prefix from a reverse
                        proxy (or ARK_TRUST_PROXY=1)
